programs.title: Man, Woman, Wild
programs.desc: In the program, a married couple takes up the challenge and tries to survive in the wilderness.Mykel Hawke is an expert in the US Army Special Forces Survival School, and his wife Ruth is a television journalist.We will meet them in the most remote and dangerous corners of the world, where they will have to survive for four days with only a knife.This is one of the most difficult exams that will test not only their resilience, but also the durability of their marriage in extreme situations.Mykel was taught how to survive in any conditions.However, for Ruth, encounters with wildlife are a completely new experience.A man will have to teach his wife how to build a roof over her head and how to look for food.

programs.title: COOL gadget
programs.desc: Vienio will present further travel gadgets.It will land, among others:in the forest, where he will test three different camping stoves in field conditions and check the operation of the fire starter.As usual, he will get modern items that are only at the testing stage and are not yet available for sale.Such a hit in the United States was, among others,a Baubax jacket that broke the bank in its early stages.Its creators' account received $3 million in funding from people who wanted to buy it.The presenter will check for himself whether it is worth purchasing.

programs.title: COOL gadget
programs.desc: Vienio will test travel gadgets and tourist essentials.He will show you a unique sleeping bag in which, apart from sleeping comfortably, you can also:walk and dance.The driver will also ensure the comfort of those traveling by car.I will test a car mat that has many massage functions.Next, he will try coffee from Colombia, Brazil and Honduras and check several types of thermal mugs.In the finale of the episode, he will move to Thailand, where he will present another modern gadget - a translator, thanks to which you can communicate with locals without knowing a foreign language.
